faq.q: Do I need to know code to manage it?
faq.a: No. Prices, texts, bookings and leads are all managed from the admin panel you just tried. You get a recorded video walkthrough too.

faq.q: Which payment systems can you connect?
faq.a: Stripe (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay), PayPal, LemonSqueezy, crypto, YooKassa, Robokassa, CloudPayments, Payme, Click and Uzum Bank. You open the merchant account and pay its fees; I integrate it. Uzbek and Russian gateways need a local company and usually take 1–3 weeks to approve.

faq.q: Will it work in my language and currency?
faq.a: Yes. Every text lives in translation files (EN/RU/UZ or any other), adapted to each market — not machine-translated. Prices convert on the fly.
30 days of support, documentation, and you own 100% of the code and accounts. Optional monthly care plan for new features.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Chameleon Engine is a demonstration product. This page explains exactly what it stores and why.

sections.p: Account: name, business name, email, industry, language and a scrypt hash of your password (never the password itself). Leads and test orders you create. Integration settings — bot tokens and webhook URLs are encrypted with AES-256-GCM.
One essential, httpOnly session cookie that keeps you signed in, and your language/currency preference in local storage. No analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.
IP address and browser name are stored with your sessions and used to rate-limit sign-in attempts. Rate-limit records are deleted after 24 hours.
Hosting (Vercel) and the database (Turso). Telegram, Slack or your webhook receive lead data only if you connect them. Payments in this demo are test transactions — no card data is collected.

Anonymous demo leads and orders are deleted after 7 days. Your account data stays until you delete it: Dashboard → Settings → Danger zone removes your account and everything linked to it immediately. You can also export your leads as CSV at any time.
Questions about your data: message me on Fiverr via the link at the bottom of the home page.

sections.p: Chameleon Engine shows what a conversion-focused business web app can do. It is provided free, as is, without warranties or uptime guarantees, and data may be reset during maintenance.
All checkouts run in test or sandbox mode. No real money is charged and nothing is sold through this site.

You keep ownership of everything you enter. You can export your leads and delete your account at any time.
